levoelkerschlacht.name: Monument to the Battle of the Nations
levoelkerschlacht.slogan: Five hundred steps up a granite giant for the whole of Saxony.
levoelkerschlacht.line: Opened on 18 October 1913, a hundred years after the battle, it stands 91 metres tall.

lethomaskirche.name: Thomaskirche
lethomaskirche.slogan: Where Bach led the choir for 27 years and still rests.
lethomaskirche.line: Johann Sebastian Bach was Thomaskantor here from 1723 until his death in 1750; his grave lies in the chancel.

lenikolaikirche.name: Nikolaikirche
lenikolaikirche.slogan: Palm columns inside, a peaceful revolution outside.
lenikolaikirche.line: After the peace prayers of 9 October 1989, some 70,000 people marched around the Leipzig ring road without violence.

leschlosskirchewb.name: Schlosskirche Wittenberg
leschlosskirchewb.slogan: The door where one hammer changed Europe.
leschlosskirchewb.line: Luther's 95 Theses are said to have been posted here in 1517; the wooden door burned and was replaced by bronze in 1858.

leauerbachskeller.name: Auerbachs Keller
leauerbachskeller.slogan: Goethe's students drank here, and Faust met the devil.
leauerbachskeller.line: My Leipzig, I praise it! It is a little Paris and educates its people.
